findings: In meaning_history.senses[1].text, relationships[1].text, and meaning_history.limitations[0].text, remove the claim that the oracle-bone referent is tentative or disputed between sources. 字源 p. 885 says “可能指的是火星” without specifying 心宿二 or the planet Mars; the CUHK 火 and 晶 entries identify historical 火星 here as 大火/心宿二. State these differing levels of specificity without implying a disagreement, and retain X-17999ee51cf046684881 in each affected evidence_ids array. The sources attest the star-name use but do not establish why the star was called 火 or a semantic connection with literal fire.
